mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eco_location ( location_name, location_type, admin_dong, road_address, jibun_address, latitude, longitude ) VALUES ( #{locationName}, #{locationType}, #{adminDong}, #{roadAddress}, #{jibunAddress}, #{latitude}, #{longitude} )
mapper.select: SELECT location_id AS locationId, location_name AS locationName, location_type AS locationType, admin_dong AS adminDong, road_address AS roadAddress, jibun_address AS jibunAddress, latitude, longitude FROM eco_location WHERE location_type = #{locationType}
SELECT DISTINCT location_type FROM eco_location WHERE location_type IS NOT NULL AND location_type != '' ORDER BY location_type
